method: Each final PNG was directly opened with view_image original and inspected individually in pairs. Counts refer to actual PNG images, not source cells or animation poses.
scope: Visual identity, targeting labels, orientation, framing and visible contact/protection cues. Timing, costs, pause, damage and 16-cell coverage are established separately by the exact bound runtime report.
limitations: Generated pixel art is a source-coherent adaptation, not an official or certified 1:1 asset.
A fixed impact capture cannot establish all animation states or timing; no unseen state is counted as visually inspected.
